verdict.rationale: ROS 2 documents a GUI-free ROS-Base install with command-line tools only, plus a scriptable `ros2` CLI (topic pub/echo, bag record/play, doctor) and a launch system for coordinating multiple nodes, all of which support headless, scripted operation. Nothing in the evidence addresses running it in CI pipelines. Missing for 10: explicit CI/automation documentation (e.g. CI integration, test runners in pipelines, container images), non-interactive/headless operation guidance, independent or hands-on corroboration of CI use.
